deviations: D1: DispatcherOrCustomer policy added to AuthorizationPolicies — sixth policy with RequireRole(Dispatcher, FleetAdmin, Customer). No existing test broke.

D2: scheduledAt future-check is in the endpoint (not the validator), using injected TimeProvider. Validator cannot inject TimeProvider without a factory — endpoint guard with AddError(r => r.ScheduledAt, ..., ScheduledAtMustBeFuture) + ErrorsAsync(400) is the correct placement. Test renamed from 'CreateOrderValidator_ScheduledInPast_FailsWithCode' to 'CreateOrder_ScheduledInPast_Returns400WithCode' (HTTP-level test via the endpoint).

D3: PublicCode charset is ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 (A-Z minus I/O, digits 2-9, excludes 0/1). Random using RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32(Charset.Length) for cryptographic randomness. Retry loop catches DbUpdateException with Npgsql.PostgresException inner with SqlState 23505 on the orders(fleet_id, public_code) unique index; bounded to 5 retries then rethrows.

D4: GetOrder uses no Policies() call — requires authenticated user (FastEndpoints default, same as Logout endpoint). Fine-grained role gating in HandleAsync: Dispatcher always allowed (tenant filter enforces fleet isolation), Driver only if assigned (resolve via UserId→Driver row), Customer only if CustomerUserId == sub. All denials return 404 (no-leak).

D5: Seeding for GetOrder_AssignedDriver test uses OrderService.TransitionAsync (via DI scope) to advance New→Assigned. This is the correct approach per WI-08 notes ('seed transitions through OrderService'). Direct Status set was avoided.
D6: Order entity had ambiguity with FastEndpoints.Order — resolved via 'using OrderEntity = Taxi.Api.Infrastructure.Entities.Order;' alias in CreateOrderEndpoint.cs.
D7: Customer creates order with Source=App (not Phone) as per the WI spec. Dispatcher creates with Source=Dispatcher.
D8: Created OrderEvent uses FromStatus=New and ToStatus=New (order is created in New, no state transition). ActorRole is set from caller role.

D9: All new ErrorCodes added to ErrorCodes.cs: PickupAddressRequired, PickupCoordsRequired, DropoffCoordsRequired, PassengersMinOne, FixedPriceCzkRequired, FixedPriceCzkNotAllowed, ScheduledAtMustBeFuture, NoTenantResolved, PageMinOne, PageSizeRange.
D10: ListOrders validator enforces page>=1 and pageSize 1-200. Search uses EF.Functions.ILike for CustomerName, .Contains for CustomerPhone, and ILike for exact PublicCode (case-insensitive).

MF-F1: Added ErrorCodes.Validation.InvalidCustomerIdentity = 'Validation.InvalidCustomerIdentity' to Common/ErrorCodes.cs. Unparseable-sub and customer-row-not-found paths in CreateOrderEndpoint now emit this distinct code instead of NoTenantResolved.

MF-F2: Removed r => r.PickupAddress property expression from the three non-field guard AddError calls (no-tenant, unparseable-sub, customer-row-not-found). Now using AddError(message, code) — request-level attribution via FastEndpoints string overload.
MF-F3: Extended GetOrder_AssignedDriver_Returns200WithAllowedActions to also assert the dispatcher's view of the same Assigned order: reassign and cancel present, accept absent.

MF-F4: Dispatcher missing-phone guard now emits PhoneRequired (new IsNullOrWhiteSpace check before TryNormalize), while an unparseable/invalid phone still emits PhoneInvalid. PhoneRequired constant already existed in ErrorCodes.cs.
notes: 18 new tests (11 integration + 7 unit validator). Previous total: 100. New total: 118. Key design choices: (1) DispatcherOrCustomer as 6th policy; (2) scheduledAt checked in endpoint not validator; (3) PublicCode charset ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 with 5-retry loop; (4) GetOrder no-Policies() with handler-level role gating; (5) OrderService.TransitionAsync used for seeding Assigned state in tests. The WI verification filter 'FullyQualifiedName~Taxi.Api.Tests.Orders.Write' matches both the integration test class OrderWriteTests and the unit test class CreateOrderValidatorTests — both are in the same namespace and folder. No migration needed (all entities already exist). Format check passed clean.
